notes.title: Hot Pot Game 1.0.0 Released!
notes.content: [h1]Hot Pot Game has launched on Steam![/h1][p][/p][p]Today is a wonderful day, let's celebrate a birth of a new generation of merge puzzle![/p][p]Thank you for your cooperating.[/p][p][/p][p]From now, i focuses on fixing bugs and developing new content.[/p][p]I hope you enjoy cooking hot pot![/p][p][/p][p]theis[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Announcing Launch Date
notes.content: [p]Greetings! I'm theis, developer of Hot Pot Game.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Announcing Launch Date[/b] [/h2][p][/p][p]Hot Pot Game full version will be launched for [b]August 4th[/b].[/p][p]The full version will include[/p][list][*][p][b]50+ Unique Items. Some has incredible power that changes even game rules![/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]6 Unique Game Modes[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]60+ Achievements[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]World wide leaderboards[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Balance changes[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]New unique item "The thousand paws"[/b][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964192/204ef753248f14070a607c0b5515821f9495804b.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964192/204ef753248f14070a607c0b5515821f9495804b.gif"][/img][/url][/h3][p]The thousand paws changes positions of two objects, even order of foods.[/p][p]If you change a cabbage and a prawn positions in food order, merging potatoes will be a cabbage instead of a prawn.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Game Mode "Abnormality Mode"[/b][/h3][p][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964192/0d3cb2e3bec85e9acbf1cc4a3cace38aa0e9cefa.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964192/0d3cb2e3bec85e9acbf1cc4a3cace38aa0e9cefa.gif"][/img][/url][/p][p]In "Abnormality mode", you face many variety of abnormalities, for example, an eruption, shooting stars, or space travel. 30+ abnormalities await your challenge.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Game Mode "Chestnuts Mode"[/b][/h3][p][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964192/5d23cdea89244137a92c945300cc099dd90c3984.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964192/5d23cdea89244137a92c945300cc099dd90c3984.gif"][/img][/url][/p][p]In "Chestnuts mode",  obstacle chestnuts spawn over time, you need to cook up fast or a pot will be filled uneatable annoying barbed nuts.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Game Mode "Magnet Mode"[/b][/h3][p][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964192/8ce5915b926da471ce10b0cf1f6c35e2277e9983.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964192/8ce5915b926da471ce10b0cf1f6c35e2277e9983.gif"][/img][/url][/p][p]In "Magnet mode", the pot has gone, and drop ingredients into a revolting magnet.[/p][p][/p][p]See you again in August 4th![/p]

notes.title: Dev blog #4
notes.content: [p]Hello all skillful hot pot cooks.[/p][p][/p][p]This may be the last dev blog before full release.[/p][p]We're glad to introduce 2 innovative game mode "[b]Chestnut mode[/b]" and "[b]Magnet mode[/b]" you can play on the full release.[/p][p][/p][h1]Chestnut mode[/h1][p]in chestnut mode, garbage obstruction chestnuts spawns periodically ,but you can eliminate them on merge foods.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964192/5d23cdea89244137a92c945300cc099dd90c3984.gif"][/img][/p][p]Spawning number of chestnuts is getting bigger over time.[/p][p]So you need to move fast, there is no time to waste![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]Magnet mode[/h1][p]In magnet mode, the pot has gone, instead of that, you use the powerful magnets that attracts anything.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964192/8ce5915b926da471ce10b0cf1f6c35e2277e9983.gif"][/img][/p][p]A completely different strategy is required than in normal mode.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]In the end, about release date, if all goes well, hot pot game will be released on July.[/p]

notes.title: Dev blog #3
notes.content:
Hello all skillful hot pot cooks.

We're glad to introduce new innovative game mode "[b]Abnormality mode[/b]" you can play on the full release.
In abnormality mode, as the name suggests, abnormal situations occur periodically.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964192/0d3cb2e3bec85e9acbf1cc4a3cace38aa0e9cefa.gif[/img]

Don't worry, the abnormality won't happen right away.
First, the next abnormality that will occur will be announced, so prepare for it as much as possible.
Every time you put an ingredient in, the countdown continues, and when it hits 0, an abnormality will occur.

Currently, over 20 abnormalities listed.
Some abnormalities are beneficial, while others are destructive.
Depending on the player's strategy, they can even be a turning point.

Here are some examples:
・A volcano.
・Money will fall from the sky.
・The pot will tilt.
・The ingredients will become more fresh.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964192/44f1e9620da1ad10c48713c2797035f5ab459af3.gif[/img]

It will be a while before the game is full released. Thank you for your patience and understanding.

notes.title: Dev blog #2
notes.content:
Hello all skillful hot pot cooks.
Hot pot game is currently under developing for full release!
Today, I share you two new unique items that you can use on full version.


[h1]New Unique Items[/h1]
[b]Vacuum Cleaner (without hose) and Balance[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964192/edb062f65b500dd22f8b8434cb8fae76a2744962.gif[/img]




[b][h3]Vacuum cleaner[/h3][/b]
This innovative vacuum cleaner has invented for controlling giant growth foods. Use it for shrinking target food size, but according to law of conservation of mass, lost mass transfers another food.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964192/a3c2571025bae35d468f5e937432eb58874f9461.gif[/img]




[b][h3]Balance[/h3][/b]
Balance is symbol of equality, commerce, finance and justice since ancient ages. In these days, some law courts, government agencies  uses balance images for showing authority.
In hot pot game, balance is just one of many cooking appliances.
The effect is really simple, equalize two foods area size.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964192/11c35b883e8304c1bace5e5ace5eee3c10812b1e.gif[/img]

notes.title: Dev blog #1
notes.content:
Hello imaginative all hot pot cooks.
I'm developing the hot pot game for release day by day and step by step. Today, I share you a bit glimpse of full version feature.


[u][b]NEW UNIQUE ITEM[/b][/u]
[b]The thousand paws[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964192/9d8896bd5aedfd1d6b0c62d208b8e4c256df1820.gif[/img]


This shiny item is the advanced version of beckoning cat.
Despite of "beckoning cat" beckons object literally,  The thousand paws  [b]swaps two objects' positions[/b].
Most unique point of it, this 'objects' includes Food Merge Order in the food list.
It changes game rule entirely and provides unusual strategies and synergies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964192/204ef753248f14070a607c0b5515821f9495804b.gif[/img]

Use your creativity and discover unique item synergies for cook up delicious hot pot!



It will be a while before the game is full released. Thank you for your patience and understanding.
